Hello, I'm **Adrien Le Deunff**, a former web developer who is now transitioning into video game producing. I have always been fascinated by game creation and decided to embark on this new adventure while making the shift from technical to human-centric work.

I have a deep understanding of the fusion between technical and artistic aspects, and I am convinced that the best way to create digital products is to combine these two aspects harmoniously.

### My Team Philosophy

My design philosophy is rooted in **empathy** and **problem-solving**. I believe design starts with understanding the 'why' – the needs and motivations of my team. I rely on research, participative methodologies (Poker planning) and anticipative methods (Planning, roadmap) to ensure that the solutions I build are truly effective.

### What Drives Me

I am driven by the constant adaptation required within a team, to understand everyone's needs and constraints. It is a constant challenge to translate complex ideas into concrete and elegant solutions.

### Outside of Work

When I'm not working on a project, you can find me in the forest reconnecting with nature. When I'm not wandering around, I immerse myself in universes I find fascinating, both in video games and reading.
And when I'm doing none of that, I write scenarios that I have friends play out as role-playing game sessions.

Thanks for stopping by. Feel free to explore my [projects](/projects) and/or [get in touch](/#contact)!
